dataset: Brain Tumor MRI Dataset, Mendeley Data version 5, DOI 10.17632/zwr4ntf94j.5

preparation.matching_method: Exact SHA-256 or 63-bit grayscale pHash with Hamming distance <= 4

cross_split_audit: Zero exact or pHash-distance<=4 matches found between Train/Validation, Train/Test, or Validation/Test.
note: Near-image matching is conservative and may exclude visually similar images that are not true duplicates.
